versions.changelog:
Initial public release with full subtitle automation and time alignment via Volcengine ATA API.

- Automatically generates time-aligned SRT/ASS subtitles from audio and plain text.
- Requires WAV (16kHz mono PCM) audio and one-sentence-per-line text input.
- Includes Python CLI tool for easy command-line usage.
- Offers robust error handling and clear troubleshooting steps.
- Comprehensive setup guide for credentials and configuration.
